description: List the account's webhook endpoints with their status and events, oldest first. Addresses show only their host and a masked path, and signing secrets are never returned. Only the account owner's API keys and connected apps can read webhooks. Reading changes nothing.
name: list_webhook_endpoints

created_by.description: website: added on the website. api: added by an API key or a connected app.

destination.description: json: signed JSON. slack and teams: a readable message for a Slack or Microsoft Teams incoming webhook.

status.description: pending: waiting for the account owner to confirm it on the website; until then it receives test events only. active: receiving events. paused: deliveries stopped after sustained failures; a test event that succeeds resumes it.

url.description: The address's host and a masked path. The full address is never shown.

title: List webhook endpoints
